title: Cancer and chronic pain.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The effective management of cancer pain is one of the greatest challenges for GPs. OBJECTIVE: Pain management can be best achieved with a knowledge of the fundamentals of cancer pain and its assessment. A systematic and holistic approach to its treatment needs to be individualised for each patient, taking into account the relevant physical, psychological and spiritual factors. DISCUSSION: GPs are part of a team including oncologists, palliative care specialists, nursing services, paramedical staff, counsellors and clergy and so should know about and make use of the ever-improving support services which are available to ensure that insoluble pain problems are a rare occurrence.
